assumptions: Human decision: pruning enabled for BRANCHES ONLY; worktree pruning deferred per ADR 0022.

The audit is shipped as a canary script (scripts/branch-prune.mjs) rather than only an AGENTS.md pointer, because the harness skill's audit could not be verified to use cherry + ls-remote; the script is the verified classifier the skill or a human acts on.

A local branch is deletable only if cherry-clean against origin/main AND (its tip equals the ls-remote tip OR it has no remote and cherry shows zero unique commits) — or its PR is MERGED and the tip equals the PR headRefOid.
A local-only branch with unique commits is always kept, even with a merged PR, unless the tip equals the PR head.
Protect-list is permanent and matched before any merge logic: main, release/*, fix/mcp-tool-path-containment, fix/migrator-workflow-symlink-escape.
No remote deletion flag exists at all; unknown flags exit 2, so --apply-remote cannot be silently ignored.
PR state unavailable (gh missing/unauthenticated) degrades to 'keep' for every branch with unique commits, with a stderr warning; it never enables deletion.
Exit 3 when zero non-protected branches were examined, so a misconfigured CI checkout (shallow, no remote refs) reads as an abstention, not a clean sweep.
CI dry-run is advisory in dogfood.yml, not a required check.
